tool.name: Haddock3Run
tool.description: : Wrapper class for the HADDOCK3 Run module.

param.name: input_haddock_wf_data
param.label: input DIRECTORY,ZIP file
param.help: Input folder containing all the files defined in the config. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: haddock_config_path
param.label: input CFG file
param.help: Haddock configuration CFG file path. Format: [input].cfg

param.name: outname_output_haddock_wf_data
param.label: output DIRECTORY,ZIP name
param.help: Path to the output zipball containing all the current Haddock workflow data Format: [output].[format]

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: restart_from
param.label: restart_from
param.help: Restart the run from a given step, this maps to the HADDOCK3 --restart option. Step folders from the selected step onward will be deleted. Use 0 to start the run from scratch, reusing an existing non-empty run_dir.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the haddock haddock executable binary.
